item.title: Two skiers rescued in separate backcountry incidents near Mount Baker in WA
item.description: Crews rescued two people in separate incidents in backcountry areas near Mount Baker over the weekend.

item.title: Pedestrian struck, killed by car in Seattle's Capitol Hill neighborhood
item.description: Seattle police are investigating a crash that killed a 27-year-old woman in the Capitol Hill neighborhood on Monday night.

item.title: Seattle's Queer/Pride Festival announces 2026 lineup
item.description: Seattle’s Queer/Pride Festival has officially announced its 2026 lineup, bringing a dynamic slate of performers to the Capitol Hill neighborhood this summer.

item.title: Seattle weather: Light snow showers falling in some western WA lowlands
item.description: The Seattle region will see a mix of clouds and sun Tuesday, with spotty rain showers moving through the area.

item.title: First Seattle Raising Cane's opens in University District
item.description: Raising Cane’s opened its first Seattle location in the University District on Tuesday, drawing hundreds for its debut.

item.title: Seattle mayor Katie Wilson tackles surveillance, homelessness in State of the City address
item.description: Seattle Mayor Katie Wilson delivered her first State of the City address on Tuesday, focusing on homelessness, public safety and affordability.

item.title: Seattle restaurant owner says Westlake Park construction forced him to temporarily close
item.description: A downtown Seattle restaurant owner says ongoing Westlake Park construction, crime and slow city permitting have forced his business to temporarily close, while city officials say support programs are available.

item.title: Offensive coordinator Jimmie Dougherty announces departure from Washington
item.description: University of Washington offensive coordinator Jimmie Dougherty confirmed Tuesday night that he is leaving the program.

item.title: Burien, WA cold weather shelter expected to hit capacity as temperatures fall
item.description: With a wintry mix of precipitation falling in parts of the Seattle metro area Tuesday, many of those experiencing homelessness were trying to figure out where they could go to stay warm overnight.

item.title: WA governor confident millionaire tax will pass despite disagreements with democrats
item.description: A day after the Senate passed a millionaire income tax, Governor Bob Ferguson said he does not support how his democratic colleagues want to spend the billions.
